from service import relay


def entry(payload):
    return relay(payload)


def operation_entry(operation_payload):
    relay(operation_payload)
    return "handled"


def unrelated(unrelated_payload):
    return "unchanged"


def overwritten(obsolete, replacement):
    value = obsolete
    value = replacement
    return value


def callback(unused_context):
    return "callback contract"


def preserve_effect(effect):
    unused = effect()
    return "initializer must remain"
